name: – Lara Wolters – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the EU should police competition between companies. It is an opinion, not a law, so nothing changes yet. It asks the European Commission to look again at the rules on company mergers, to act against very large digital companies that block rivals, and to make sure government support for industry does not distort the single market. It also asks for Parliament to have a bigger say in competition policy.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament only states its position and requests action.
- **Who it affects:** Companies merging or dominating markets, and national governments giving State aid.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to act on these requests.
